grammar.summary: 本课学习过去进行时被动与 risk 的搭配。

points.title: 过去进行时被动
points.explanation: was being + 过去分词：The bags were being guarded by the men. 表过去某时正在被进行。

examples.en: They were being watched by two men.
examples.cn: 她们正被两个男人盯着。

points.title: risk + doing
points.explanation: risk 后接动名词：She risked running through the forest. 冒险做某事。

examples.en: Mrs. Sterling got so angry that she ran after them.
examples.cn: Sterling 太太气得追赶他们。

exercises.q: I' d love ___ (see) that film. Will it be on tomorrow?
You must never come into this room without ___ (knock) first.
